solution_summary: Numerous SaaS apps and digital tools are used in the creative pursuits of writers, creators, and editors, but issues surround the protection of intellectual property. Meanwhile, working styles have been changing rapidly since the onset of COVID-19. These challenges have made it essential to strengthen cybersecurity. Major publishing company SHUEISHA Inc. has incorporated Microsoft 365 E5, putting its features to full use. This of course includes endpoint security such as anti-virus measures, but also sustained secured connections to SaaS apps and automated management of the total network. SHUEISHA used Microsoft Security Copilot, Microsoft 365 E5, Microsoft 365 to support security and compliance with a governed operating model that connected the relevant data sources, automation logic, and employee-facing experiences without custom point-to-point tooling.
